description: Moon phases from the US Naval Observatory: the UT date and time of every New Moon, First Quarter, Full Moon and Last Quarter in a year, or the next few phases from a given date. Answers "when is the next full moon", "full moons in 2026", "what phase is the Moon in this week", "date of the new moon in October". Pass a year for the whole year, or a start date (default today) with a count for the next phases.

count.description: How many phases to return from the start date, 1-99. Default 8 (about two lunar months).

date.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD for the next phases from that day. Default today when year is omitted.

year.description: Four-digit year, 1800-2050, for every phase in that year (about 50).

name: usno_moon_phases
title: Usno Moon Phases
